author: bardic-inspiration
name: Skullbound Hound
summary: A hunting dog reduced to bone, with a human skull wired over its own and a howl that pins prey in place.
description: Gravekeepers' hounds are sometimes given the skull of a murdered master. The hound never forgets whose voice it is meant to answer.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The hound has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hound's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {ref:condition/incapacitated} condition.

actions.name: Bite
actions.onHit: If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {ref:condition/prone} condition.

bonusActions.name: Hollow Howl

save.targets: one creature within 30 feet that can hear the hound

bonusActions.onFailure: The target has the {ref:condition/frightened} condition until the end of the hound's next turn.
